rkang pa'i bol gnyis sindhu ra'i si yig gi nang du yi ge phaṭa gsum kha dog dmar po me rab tu 'bar bar bsgoms na drod skye zhing nyon mongs pa rnams bsreg par 'gyur ro// rkang lag gi mthe bong bzhi ma ro de sha'i ma yig bzhi'i nang du swa kha dog sna tshogs bsgoms na sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin myur du skye bar 'gyur ro// pus mo gnyis ku mu ta'i ku gnyis kyi nang du ha yig rdo rje pha lam gyi rnam pa de dkar ljang 'od 'bar ba gnyis bsgoms na 'chi ba med pa ste mkha' spyod myur du thob par 'gyur ro// de nas 'doms bar hi ma la ya dang rtags pre ta pu ri gnyis kyi bar na rtsa gsum ma rtser gnas pa yin te/ de nas g.yas ro ma'i me'i gseb tu yi ge hūm̐ bsgoms pas dag pa bcu bzhi mtshon te kha dog gnyis las dmar po dang*/ nyi zla gnyis las nyi ma dang*/ srid pa dang mya ngan 'das/ gnyis las srid pa dang*/ sprul sku dang longs sku gnyis las sprul sku dang*/ nyin mo dang mtshan mo gnyis las nyin mo/ rnam shes dang ye shes gnyis las rnam shes/ dus dang dus med gnyis las dus dang*/ thabs shes gnyis las thabs dang*/ kun rdzob dang don dam gnyis las kun rdzob dang*/ lho dang byang gnyis las lho dang*/ khrag dang khu ba gnyis las khrag dang*/ dbugs 'byin pa dang 'jug pa gnyis las 'byin pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa gnyis las nyon mongs pa dang*/ de rnams dag pa dang zad pa dang chos mthun pa yin no// g.yon rkyang mar hūm̐ yig bsgoms pas kyang snga ma bzhin du bcu bzhi dag ste kha dog dkar po dang*/ zla ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa dang*/ stong pa chen po dang*/ mtshan mo dang*/ ye shes dang*/ dus med pa dang*/ shes rab dang*/ don dam pa/ byang du bgrod pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems 'bab dang*/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dang*/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams mtshon cing dag la 'joms par byed pa yin no// dbu ma'i gnas su hūm̐ yig kha dog sngon po bsgoms pas ni chos kyi sku ste gong ma thams cad kyi zung 'jug ston par byed pa yin no// de lta bu'i hūm̐ gsum las me 'bar te lte ba'i aṃ 'bar/

des spyi bor oṃ gsum zhu nas lte ba'i aṃ la babs pa'i tshul du bsam ste/ ā li kā li zhes bya ba g.yas g.yon gyi rlung 'gog pa kha sbyar gyi dmigs pa byas nas ye shes thams cad dang dngos grub thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro// de nas bdag med ma spros pa thams cad dang bral bar shugs kyis rgyud la skyes pa bskyangs na rdo rje 'chang nyid thob par 'gyur ro// spros pa bral ba'i bshad pa zhib tu gzhung nyid kyi steng du rtogs par bya'o// zhal gnyis ma'i rjes la 'di bstan cing 'di bshad pa'i rjes su slob ma rjes su bzung ba zhes bya ba las bcu gzhan la bstan par bya'o// sngags kyi de nyid sgrub pa'i don gsal 'di// tsang nge 'dul ba 'dzin pas gsol btab nas// dpal ldan sa skya'i dgon par 'bad de bris// dge bas 'gro kun sku gsum thob par shog /shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis nye bar sbyar ba'o// ༈ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje 'chang dang mtshungs med bla ma dang*// dpal ldan mkha' 'gro bye ba'i gtso mo mchog /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// de mnyes byed pa'i cho ga gsal por bri// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha sum cu so bdun ma'am/ lha bcu gsum ma'am/ zhal gnyis ma'am/ zhal gcig ma la sogs pa gang sgor zhugs kyang rung ste/ rang dang gzhan gnyis ka'i don du byed pa las kyi yan lag bcur 'du ba yin no// de la thog mar bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang*/ gzhan don slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga dang*/ tshes bcu dang 'brel ba'i tshogs kyi mchod pa dang*/ bdag gzhan gnyis ka dang 'brel ba gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa dang*/ gnas skabs thams cad dang 'brel ba gtor ma'i cho ga dang*/ dman pa'i dur khrod dang 'brel ba sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang*/ bu chung gsar bu la phan gdags pa srung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/

las rtsub pa'i dbang du byas te gdug pa can tshar bcad pa sumbha ni'i cho ga dang*/ bsgom pas phyir bzlog pa dang*/ bris pas phyir bzlog pa ste bcu'o// dang po bsnyen pa la gnyis te/ bsgom bzlas 'ba' zhig pa'i bsnyen pa dang*/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i bsnyen pa'o// dang po thog mar mal nas bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal cung zad dran pas lus dag pa dang*/ shrī he ru ka zhes bya ba'i yi ge bzhi'i don dran pas ngag dag pa dang*/ snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ bsgoms pas yid dag par byas la chang byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ lag pa gnyis byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ sumbha ni la sogs pa zlos shing bdag dang gnas dang*/ rnal 'byor srung ba dang*/ go cha bgo ba dang*/ dag pa gsum gyi sngags brjod pa dang*/ bdag gi rnal 'byor bskyed rdzogs gnyis bsgom bzlas byas pa yin te/ mngon par rtogs pa zhib tu zhal gnyis chung ngu'i zhar rtogs par bya'o// gnyis pa mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i bsnyen pa la/ mdun bskyed rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yin te/ rgyas par byed na mdun bskyed kyi 'og sta gon gyi skabs bzhin du rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa bri/ 'bring du byed na me long la sindhu ra'i 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin bri/ bsdus te byed na me long la chang gis gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su bam̐ yig bri/ bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa dang mdun gyi rten la dam tshig pa bskyed/ de la ye shes dgug sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ dbang bskur/ de la mchod pa ci 'byor pas mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ bzod par gsol/ bzlas pa bya ste/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i lte bar chos 'byung gi tsakra'i dbus su bam̐ bsgom/ de'i mtha' ma nas phar la sngags kyi phreng ba 'ol ma se'i phung po ltar 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba dmigs la yid kyi bzlas pa dang ngag gi bzlas pa bya'o// thun 'jog khar srin lag g.yon pas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la reg la/

bdag gi lte bar reg pas/ mdun gyi lha rnams bdag gi lte bar bsdu/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ smon lam gdab/ sumbha nis bsrungs la spyod lam ci bde bar gnas par bya'o// de lta bu thun gsum mam bzhi'i rnal 'byor gyis sgo nas bsnyen pa bya'o// de la mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa rab rje btsun mas dngos su gnang ba sbyin pa/ 'bring rmi lam du snang ba thob pa/ tha ma gzhan don du snying rje chen po skye ba'o// dus kyi bsnyen pa rab zla ba gsum/ 'bring zla ba gnyis/ tha ma zla ba gcig go /bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed mchod/ gtor ma btang*/ slob mas maṇḍal phul la gsol ba gdab/ sdig pa bshags pa sngon du 'gro bas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed/ de nas slob ma gnas gzhan du ci bder nyal du gzhug slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pas tshogs la longs spyod do// phyi nyin dkyil 'khor bris la bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed mchod/ de nas slob ma dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlab par bya'o// nub gcig tu byed na nyin mo bum pa bcas la/ nub mo bdag bskyed mdun bskyed mchod la slob ma sta gon bya'o// byin gyis rlabs dbang bskur rdzogs par byas nas tshogs 'khor la longs spyod do// gang ltar yang lag tu blang ba'i rim pa 'di yin te/ tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus khyad par gyi dus su sa phyogs phyag dar bya/ maṇḍal ba byung lnga dang bcas pa'i dri zhim po dang bcas pas skyang nul bya/ tsandan dmar po'am sa tshon dmar pos dkyil 'khor gru gsum nyis brtsegs bris/ de'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du sgo mtshams ma brgyad la tshom bu brgyad bya/ rtsibs drug la rdul tshon dkar po shar gyi rtsibs nas bzung ste yi ge phyir bstan la g.yon skor gyis rim gyis/ oṃ bam̐/ ham̐ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa ces pa drug bri'o// de'i dbus su bam̐ bri/ de'i steng du ka pā la'i nang du chang la bdud rtsi sbyar bas bkang la dpral ba rang la bstan la bzhag

de'i steng du 'khar ba'i maṇḍal dri ma med pa la gur gum mam/ chang gis bsangs te phyis la sindhu ra'i phye ma btsags la rdul tshon gyis bris pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor bri/ zur bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa bzhi bris/ de'i lte bar bam̐ yig gi mthar oṃ gsum ma'i sngags bris la thod steng du bzhag go /de la dar dmar po'am ras dmar po'i gur phub bo// mchod yon zhabs bsil sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa khor yug tu bshams/ gtor ma bshams/ de nas bum pa gtsang ma ras dmar pos mgul chings bya/ kha rgyan gzugs/ sumbha ni bzlas shing*/ kha dang zhabs su gu gul gyis bdug nang du sman lnga dang 'bru lnga/ ratna lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ chu gtsang mas gang*/ dri zhim po sbyar ba'i dung chos steng du bzhag rdo rje la gzungs thag btags pa slob dpon la nye ba'i gnas sam dben pa gcig tu bzhag go /gnas kyi nye 'khor du gha na tsakra'i yo byad bsham du gzhug de nas slob dpon zhal nub phyogs su bltas te bzhugs la/ slob ma gzhan bde bar gral byas/ las kyi rdo rje slob mas maṇḍal dang me tog phreng ba phul/ lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba gdab la/ yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs/ de nas bdag gi rnal 'byor mngon rtogs kyi ri mo na yod na yang*/ zhal gnyis ma chung ba bzhin bsgoms la/ yid bzlas ngag bzlas cung zad byas/ bdag gi rnal 'byor ma mchod pa dang bstod pa dang bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar bya/ de nas mdun gyi thod pa'i chang byin gyis brlabs/ de'i steng gi sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bskyed pa'am bris pa dang rjes su mthun pa nyid gsal bar bskyed kyang btub/ de la ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya/ lhar bskyed pa yin/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ dbang bskur zhing mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab/ yi ger bskyed na de gnyis mi dgos/ de nas mchod pa bsang zhing byin gyis brlabs la/

mchod yon zhabs bsil sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa lnga dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga'i mchod pa dang*/ rdo rje dril bu bsil zhing rkang pa brgyad la sogs pa'i bstod pas bstod nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa brjod la bzod par gsol bar bya'o// de nas bum pa sumbha nis bsangs la/ swa bhā was stong par bsgoms/ bhrūm̐ las ratna'i bum par bsgom/ de'i nang du bam̐ las rdo rje phag mo dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes shes pa gzhug sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ dbang bskur la mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab/ yi ger bskyed na de gnyis mi dgos/ de nas mchod pa bsang zhing byin gyis brlabs la/ mchod yon zhabs bsil sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa lnga dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga'i mchod pa dang*/ rdo rje dril bu gsil zhing rkang pa brgyad la sogs pa'i bstod pas bstod nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa brjod la bzod par gsol bar bya'o// de nas bum pa sumbha nis bsangs la/ swa bhā was stong par bsgom/ bhrūm̐ las ratna'i bum par bsgom/ de'i nang du bam̐ las rdo rje phag mo dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ dbang bskur la mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab/ de la mchod pa lnga dang bdud rtsi lngas mchod pa dang*/ rkang pa brgyad pa la sogs pa ci shes pas bstod la/ gzungs thag nas bzung la oṃ gsum ma'i sngags bzlas pas/ sngags kyi 'od zer bdag gi zhal nas 'phros te gzungs thag la 'khril te bum pa'i nang du song bas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phog pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ste/ bum pa'i nang du bdud rtsi chu rgyun gyis mer khengs par bsam zhing sngags bzlas so// sngags brgya rtsa brgyad thon pa dang dung chos kyi chu bum pa'i nang du blugs la/ rje btsun ma 'od du zhu bas bum pa'i nang khengs par bsam mo// de nas gtor ma btang*/

de yan chad sngon du bya ba'i cho ga yin no// de nas slob ma rnams nyin mo nas bzung nas gso sbyong gi sdom pa len du gzhug de nyid kyi tshe khrus byas gral la rim gyis 'khod pa dang maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug lag tu me tog gi phreng ba bzung la/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ de nas tshigs su bcad pa 'dis sdig pa bshags pa nas bzung ste/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang bsngo ba'i bar byed pa yin te/ 'di skad du/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchod yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod pas sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ don dam byang chub kyi sems dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ smon pa dang*/ 'jug pa dang*/ yongs su bsngo ba bya'o// de yan chad sta gon gyi nub mo byas la/ phyis nub kyang ldabs nas byas pa'am/ nub gcig par byed na de yan chad sngon du 'gro ba'i tshul yin no// de nas byin gyis brlabs pa dngos ni/ slob ma rnams sbrel du bcug la/ slob ma'i gtso bo'i lag pa nas bla mas bzung ste/ 'di skad brjod par bya'o// rtog pas g.yogs pa'i sems kyis ni// legs pa'i sangs rgyas phyir bzlog ltar// dad pa'i chu yis bkrus pa'i sems// phan pa'i sems kyis 'dir 'jug bya// dad pa med pa'i sems can la// dkar po'i chos ni mi 'byung ste// ji ltar sa bon 'tshig pa la// myu gu sngon mo skye mi srid// ces brjod la de'i don yang rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs la/

lha dang bla ma la mos gus drag po bskyed cing sumbha ni bzlas shing bum pa'i chus bran/ dar dmar pos gdong bcings/ kha nub phyogs sam ci rigs par bltar bcug la/ se gol gyi sgra dang sumbha nis bsrung ba bya/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug rkang mthil gyi rlung gis sum mdo'i me sbar te/ bdag gi phung po dang khams dang skye mched dag pa gsum gyis sngags brjod cing sgyu ma lta bur mi dmigs par bsgom/ de'i skad cig la bdag rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gnyis mar bskyed/ lte bar bris pa'i 'khor lo bsgoms te/ de'i 'od g.yas ro mar song ste 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs te spyi bor bstim/ spyi gtsug haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun rtsa dbu ma nas byung ste lte bar babs pa la dmigs pa gtad pas drod skye ba'i gdams ngag go /yang lte ba nas g.yas ro ma nas song ste zhal gdangs pa'i phag gdong gi g.yung drung 'khyil pa la phyogs te myur du 'khor la dmigs pa gtad pa ni mi rtog pa bskyed pa'i gnad do// lte ba'i 'khor lo de nyid gsang gnas su phab ste myur du 'khor ba la dmigs pa ni bde ba bskyed pa'i gdams ngag go /de ltar dmigs pa gsum po gcig char mas rim gyis drag tu bsgom du bcug la/ bla mas bdug pas bdug pa/ oṃ gsum ma'i sngags sgra mi che bar bzlas shing ḍā ma ru'am dril bu'i sgra mi che bar brdungs pas slob ma'i rgyud la ye shes skye ba ni/ ba spu ldang ba la sogs pa'am/ ngag tu brjod pa la sogs pa'am/ sems la mi rtog pa skye ba la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro// de nas spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ oṃ tiṣṭha badzra zhes pa dang*/ ye shes pa brtan par gyur cig ces brjod par bya'o// de nas gdong phye la dkyil 'khor bstan no// byin rlabs kyi rim pa'o// de nas dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/

byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal pa ltar// bdag kyang drang ba'i don gyis phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje bdag la stsol// zhes brjod la/ de nas bla ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar sgoms shig brjod la bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod cing*/ dngos su bum pa'i spyi bo nas mar la dngos su dbang bskur zhing tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs nas chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas brgyan par bsgoms la bum pa'i dbang thob pa yin no// zhes ngo sprad do// de nas sindhu ra'i 'og gi thod pa blangs la yi ge gsum dang sngags zlos shing slob ma rnams 'thung du gzhug gsang dbang thob pa yin no zhes gsung ngo*// de nas yang sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi sngags phreng rnams bla ma'i srin lag g.yon pas blangs pa'i sindhu ra lte bar byugs cing sngags lan gcig bzlas la sngags rnams lte bar thim par bsgom/ yang g.yung drung 'khyil pa'i sindhu ra rnams blangs la sngags zlos shing dpral bar byugs bas dga' ba 'khyil pa rnams smin mtshams su thim par bsgoms mo// yang go cha'i sindhu ra rnams blangs la go cha'i sngags rnams zlos shing spyi gtsug tu reg pas go cha'i sngags spyi gtsug tu thim par bsgom pa ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang yin no// zhes ngo sprod do// de nas sngags kyi byin rlabs kyi rgyun gang yin pa cig bsgom du bcug la/ dbang bzhi pa yin no zhes ngo sprod do// de nas zhal gnyis ma chung ba nas 'byung ba'i mngon rtogs dang dam tshig spyod pa gcig bstan la/ re zhig don grub pa yin no zhes ngo sprad do// de nas slob ma rnams kyis bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas te yon phul la gral rim gyis 'khod par bya'o// de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad yongs la byin gyis brlabs la/

longs spyod pa'i mjug tu sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor mchod la/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab la bzod par gsol te ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu ba dang*/ sindhu ra'i dman ma bsrung ba'i don du gnyer ba rnams la sbyin te/ de dag gi bsrung ba'i don du bsgom pa'am/ dpung pa la gdags par bya'o// gnyis pa gzhan don du slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga bstan zin to// gsum pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga la lnga/ dad pa med pas mi bya ba dang*/ gnas khang brgyan par bya ba dang*/ dgos pa dang*/ snyan gsan dbab par bya ba dang*/ cho ga'o// de la bzhi/ cha dang po gral rim gyis 'khod de/ lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par zhu ba phul/ bdag gi rnal 'byor bsgom bzlas dang*/ cha gnyis pa ni/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa rnams la las kyi rdo rjes mchod par bya'o// cha gsum pa ni/ tshogs kyi yo byad btegs la/ byin brlabs byas te/ las kyi rdo rjes phud bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la gtor ma phul nas rim pa bzhin du tshogs kyi longs spyod drangs te/ longs spyod pa'i tshe snying ga'i bam̐ yig dang lha tshim par bya ba dang*/ bdag dang yon bdag gi sdig pa zhi bar bya ba dang*/ bsod nams rgyas pa la sogs pa gang 'dod pa'i bsam pas longs spyod na phan yon de dang de dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro// de'i dus ni 'dren pa dang len pa'i tshigs bcad dang byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags dang gsol ba btab pa'am/ phyag 'tshal ba'i tshigs su bcad pa nyid ni gzhung nyid du rtogs par bya'o// gzhan kha zas kyis tshim pa dang*/ rdo rje glu blang ba dang gar gyis kyang tshim par bya ba yin no// cha bzhi pa ni/ yon bdag gi gos dang*/ rta la sogs pa yon phul la bzod par gsol ba dang*/ lhag ma bsdus te 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas kha la yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ sarba bhakṣa la sogs pa lan gsum brjod la se gol gtogs la phyi rol du btang ngo*// de nas bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dang smon lam btab la las kyi rjes bsdu bar bya'o// tshogs kyi bya ba bstan zin to// don bzhi pa gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa byed par 'dod na/

don drug ste/ dus dang*/ grogs dang*/ gnas dang*/ yo byad dang*/ cho ga dang*/ dgos pa'o// de la dang po dus ni/ grub na zla re la yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu gnyis so// de ma grub na zla ba re la 'khor re'o// de'ang ma grub na lo gcig gi dgun 'bring po ste/ rgyal gyi zla ba la bsod nams gsog par 'dod na yar ngo'i tshes bcu/ sgrib pa zad par 'dod na mar ngo'i tshes bcu ste dgun gyi dus yin no// khyad par dus ni slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i dus grub na bya ste/ de yang nyin mo gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa bya ste nub mo slob ma'i bya ba'am/ mtshan mo nyid gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa bya ste/ de nas slob mas byas kyang btub bo// yang na zla ba gcig gi gang la/ snga nyin tsam nas gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa byas kyang nyes pa med de shin tu legs so// grogs gzhon nu ma ni gcig nas bzung ste sum cu so bdun gyi bar lha grangs dang mthun pa/ grong ba'i chos kyis ma phog pa sum cu'am bcu gnyis yan chad yin/ mang po bsog par 'dod cing de lta bu ma rnyed na dam tshig dang sdom pa dang ldan pa cung zad rgan pa 'ga' yang bsod nams kyi kha bskang du nyes pa med do// gsum pa gnas ni/ gzhon nu de rnams kun dam tshig thob na dkyil 'khor gyi khang par 'bod la/ dam tshig ma thob na gnas khang gtsang mar bcas pa gzhan nam khang pa yang ba na gnas de nyid du yol bas bar du bcad la/ gzhon nu ma rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi rdzas rnams mi mthong bar slob dpon gyis mthong pa'i sar bzhag pa yin no// yo byad ni gzhon nu ma rnams la dgos pa rnams nye 'khor du tshags byed pa yin no// cho ga la don bcu gnyis su gnas pa yod pa las/ snyan gsan dbab pa/ khrus bya ba/ nang du 'bod pa dang*/ ku sha la sogs pa'i stan la bzhag pa dang*/ sumbha ni la sogs pas bgegs bsrung ba dang*/ slob dpon bdag lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas bzlas brjod bya ba dang*/

drug gis rtogs pa sla'o// bdun pa brten pa lhar bskyed pa ni/ gzhon nu ma gcig las med na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bskyed/ lnga yod na snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang lngar bskyed/ drug yod na go cha'i rnal 'byor ma drug tu bskyed/ bdun yod na 'di ni byin rlabs shin tu che ste/ go cha'i rnal 'byor ma drug dang rdo rje phag mo dang bdun du bskyed do// yang na ni ya mi ni la sogs bdun nam/ gzugs can ma la sogs pa bdun du bskyed/ brgyad ya mi ni la sogs pa bdun rdo rje phag mo dang brgyad du bskyed/ bcu gsum yod na lha bcu gsum ma la sogs pa/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod na 'khor lo gsum gyi rnal 'byor ma bskyed/ sum cu so bdun yod na rnal 'byor ma so bdun du bskyed la/ rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma spyan drangs la bzhugs par bsam/ gzhon nu ma la bstim pa ni ma yin no// don brgyad pa mchod pa ni/ de rnams la mchod yon zhabs bsil sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga/ gla rtsi ga pur la sogs pa'i dri sbyar ba lus la byugs/ sindhu ra dpral bar byugs/ li ku mig la sogs pa'i mig sman mig la bku/ dar la sogs pa'i na bza' dmar po dbul/ me tog dmar po'i phreng ba dbul/ bdug spos kyi mchod pas mchod/ sha dang chang la sogs pa'i ston mos tshim par bya'o// de nas gtor ma rgya chen pos mchod par bya'o// //dgu pa ltas brtag pa ni/ dang po gral byas ma thag dang*/ zas la longs spyod kha ma dang*/ gyes pa'i dus dang gsum du 'byung*/ dge ba la/ lus gar byed pa/ ngag sngags su brjod pa/ lung ston pa/ bkra shis brjod par bya'o// mi shis pa la/ ngu ba dang*/ rtsod pa drag po 'byung ba/ ngag la bkra mi shis pa'i lung ston pa dang*/ grogs dang bla'i mtshang 'dru ba la sogs pa ngan pa'i rtags dus rnam pa gsum du 'byung ba na srung ba rnams gces te/ de la gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa bskyar la bya'o// srung ba gsum ni/

dpa' bo'i go cha dang*/ dpa' mo'i sumbha ni sngags bzlas so// bcu pa bzod par gsol zhing smon lam rgya chen po gdab pa'o// bcu gcig pa yon phul la gshegs su gsol ba'o// bcu gnyis pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub mtha' dag 'byung ba'i phan yon btag pa ste/ spyi don drug pa yang thun mong du bstan pa yin no// gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa bstan zin to// lnga pa gnas skabs thams cad dang 'brel pa gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ sha la sogs pas nye bar bkang ba'i rdzas mdun du nye bar bzhag ste/ chang la sogs pas sbyangs la/ sumbha ni'i sngags kyis bgegs sbyangs/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsgom/ yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las thod pa gsum gyi sgyed pu'o// steng du āḥdamar po las thod pa dkar po'o// de'i nang du shar du oṃ las dri chen/ lho ru traṃ las rakta/ nub tu aṃ las byang sems/ byang du khaṃ las klad pa'i brgyangs pa/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ byang shar du aṃ las khyi'i sha/ dbus su hūm̐ las mi'i sha'o// de'i steng du zla ba/ zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las kha ṭwāṃ ga rtse mo mthur la bstan pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'o// de'i steng du oṃ/ de'i steng du āḥ de'i steng du hūm̐ bsam par bya'o/ de nas rlung gis mi sbar thod pa bsros/ thod pa'i nang gi bdud rtsi rnams nyi ma gzhon nu'i 'od ltar dmar ser du bsam par bya'o// de nas yi ge gsum las sku gsung thugs kyi lha'i 'khor lo 'od zer du spros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas yi ge de nyid la zhugs par bsam mo// de nas yi ge gsum po thod pa'i nang du lhung nas zhu ba las/ oṃ gyis kha dog phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur par bsam/ āḥyis dri phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsam/ hūm̐ gis ro phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsam/ kha ṭwāṃ ga las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/

kha ṭwāṃ ga yang zhu zhing babs pas nus mthu phun sum tshogs par bsam zhing*/ ngag tu oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa lan gsum brjod par bya'o// oṃ badzra a ra li'i sngags kyis/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dur khrod brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ mdun du bzhugs su gsol te/ mchod pa lnga dang*/ bdud rtsi'i mchod pas kyang mchod la/ lag pa rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ a ra li'i sngags btab la ye shes pa rnams mnyes par bya'o// 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab nas/ lha mo tshad ma zhes smon lam btab nas/ chos thams cad bdag med par dran par byas la/ de nas gtor ma gnyis yod kyang rung*/ de nyid la yang rung ste/ dur khrod chen po brgyad la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong rnams la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ la sogs pa'i sngags rnams kyis phyogs rnams g.yon bskor/ mtshams rnams la g.yas skor gyis phul bas/ rje btsun ma'i sngags rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod la/ mngon par 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo// lhag chad kha bskang ba'i ched du yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod do// de'i rjes la oṃ badzra muḥzhes bya ba brjod la/ pad skor gyi phyag rgya bskor bas dgyes par byas la/ lha mo mgron rnams mi dmigs par bya'o// de nas tshogs kyi cho ga dang 'brel na lhag ma rnams bsdus la bya/ lhag ma med na yang chang gis kha bskang ste/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas te/ hūm̐ phaiṃ zhes bya ba'i kha phru gtor ma de nyid snod gcig tu btab la/ oṃ sarba bhakṣa zhes pa'i sngags kyis btab la/ lhag ma la dga' ba rnams tshim par bya ste se gol gtogs la/ rang gi gnas su btang bar bya'o// gtor ma'i cho ga bstan zin to// drug pa sbyin sreg la gnyis/ nang gi sbyin sreg dang phyi'i 'o// dang po kha zas byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgom ste/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig lte ba'i me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par tshim pa'i rnam pas bza' ba ste/

'di ni tshogs dang kha zas 'brel ba yin no// phyi'i sbyin sreg ni las bzhi dang 'brel te sgrub pa po chas gos ldan pas thab bya ba ni las bzhi ka'i thab khung brtsigs te/ chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dbyibs can rtse mo bdag la bstan pa/ rgyar khru gang zabs su khru phyed pa kha dog dkar pos byugs pa'i lte bar rdo rje dmar po bris/ sor gsum gyi phyi dor ba la gri gug gi phreng ba bris/ sor gsum dpangs su brtsigs te rdo rje'i phreng ba bris la/ las dang rjes su mthun pa'i shing brtsigs/ sumbha ni'i sngags kyis bsrung zhing rdo rje'i rwa ba dang gur la sogs pa skad cig gis bsam/ arghaṃ la sogs pa mchod pa'i rdzas dang*/ sumbha ni bzlas pa'i bum pa g.yas su bshams/ bsreg rdzas rnams dang gtor ma g.yon du bshams/ rdo rje dril bu dang dgang gzar dang thod pa chang la bdud rtsi blugs pa rnams mdun du bzhag la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms la mchod de bzlas pa cung zhig bya/ thab tu me sbar la sumbha nis bgegs bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par bsgom/ skad cig mas bris pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i thab bskyed/ thab kyi dbus su ram̐ las bsgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'jig rten pa'i me lha dam tshig pa bskyed par bya ste/ de yang dam tshig pa bskyed pa dang*/ ye shes pa gzhug pa dang*/ mchod pas mchod pa dang*/ bsreg rdzas dbul ba dang*/ mchod cing bstod pa dang*/ de la dngos grub blang ba dang*/ gtor ma btang ba dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha rje btsun ma/ me lha'i thugs kar cho ga rdzogs par bskyed pa dang*/ de la mchod cing bsreg rdzas dbul ba dang*/ yang mchod cing bstod de bzod par gsol ba dang*/ gtor ma btang nas yang nas yang du gsol ba btab ste gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ yang 'jig rten pa'i me lha lhag mas mchod de/ 'dod pa'i don blangs te bzod par gsol ba dang*/ lhag chad kha bskang ba'i don du yi ge brgya pa bzla ba rnams ni gzhung nyid du gsal lo// de yang sbyin sreg 'di cha drug pa zhes gsungs te/

cha dang po sgrub pa po'i chas gos dang*/ cha gnyis pa thab dang 'brel ba dang*/ gsum pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa dang*/ bzhi pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa dang*/ lnga pa gtor ma btang ba dang*/ drug pa 'jig rten pa mchod pa'o// sbyin sreg bstan zin to// bdun pa srung ba'i 'khor lo bri ba ni/ dpe chung dang gzhung nyid du gsal lo// tsakra'i rab gnas byed par 'dod na/ tsakra snod gtsang mar bzhag gtor ma dang mchod pa ci 'byor bar bshams/ bdag gi rnal 'byor bsgom bzlas bya/ de nas tsakra mi dmigs par stong pa bsgom pa las/ padma dang zla ba'i steng du bam̐ yig dkar po ji lta ba bzhin du bskyed la/ de la ye shes kyi 'khor lo dkar po de 'dra ba cig spyan drangs la gzhug mchod pa ci 'byor gyis mchod/ gtor ma chos skyong la phul la bar chad zhi bar gsol ba gdab bo// de nas lus la bcang ba dang*/ gnas dben par bzhag ste mchod pa byas te bcang ba'i lugs gnyis ni gzhung du gsal lo// srung ba'i 'khor lo bstan zin to// brgyad pa sumbha ni'i cho ga ni/ bsnyen pa sngon du song ba gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur ro// de nas tsakra bri ba ni dpe chung dang gzhung nyid du gsal lo// de ltar bris pa'i tsakra de la cha'i nang du bcug pa bdun bya/ bsnyen sgrub tshar ba dang*/ las sbyor gyi dus su me'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba g.yos rgyun mi chad pa byed pa'i sgyed pu'i 'og tu bcug pa dang*/ zla ba gcig la sogs pa ma shen spog chog ni/ klu gnas pa'i chu mig gi sngon slob dpon 'di ni bzhed par klu'i chos 'byung du bzhed pas de'i nang du phur bu btab la/ rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas zla ba re la ril bu re bskyur nas zla ba bdun gyis dgra rnams brlag par 'gyur ro// sumbhu ni'i cho ga bstan zin to// de nas bsgom pas phyir bzlog pa ni/ gnas dben par stan bde ba la 'dug la/ byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom/

rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgom/ snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi phyi rol du rtsibs bcu pa'i tsakra/ de'i nang du rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal bar bsgom/ rtsibs drug la go cha'i rnal 'byor ma drug bskyed/ phyogs kyi rtsibs brgyad la sgo mtshams ma brgyad bskyed la/ de rnams ni gzhung gzhan dang mthun pa bzhin bsgom/ steng 'og gnyis su mkha' spyod ma dang sa spyod ma gnyis ni sku mdog nag mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o// de ltar bskyed la ye shes pa dgug pa dang*/ mchod bstod dang bdud rtsi myang ba bya ste/ sngags bzlas pa dang*/ lha rnams zhal phyir gzigs shing*/ 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor bas gnod byed rnams tshar gcod par bsgoms pa 'di ni bsgoms pas phyir bzlog pa bstan zin no// bcu pa bris pas phyir bzlog pa ni/ bsgom pa la gos gyon pa la sogs pa rmis ltas bzang po byung na bri bar bya'o// bris gzhi ras sam shog bu la gur gum mam gi waṃ gis bsgom pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i tsakra bris te/ lte ba la oṃ gsum ma la rakṣa spel/ rtsibs rnams la rang rang gi sngags la rakṣaḥspel ba bri/ mu khyud la phyir bzlog gi sngags rakṣaḥspel ba bris la/ rab gnas bsrung ba'i gnas skabs su bstan pa bzhin du lus la bcangs na bar du gcod pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro// bris pas phyir bzlog pa bstan zin to// las bcu po 'di ni rnal 'byor thams cad kyi yan lag ma tshang ba rnams tshang bar byed pa yin mod kyi/ gtso bo zhal gnyis ma chung bar grags pa dang*/ sngags kyi de nyid grub pa'i yan lag yin no// de nas 'di ni ind+ra bhu ti'i chos gsum bya ba yin no// 'di'i brgyud pa ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sras sam slob ma lwa ba pa/ de'i slob ma ind+ra bhu ti/ des lcam legs smin/

lakṣ+mi/ des rje btsun birwa bram ze pa/ des a bhi dzukta bya ba la/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma thams cad hang du dkar pos phal skad la bsngag par 'di ltar zer zhes chags lor gsungs/ gsan skad/ yang birwa pa la/ sha ba ri pa la/ des mai tri pa la/ des rgya gar phyag na/ des bla ma hang du dkar bha ran dra ru tsa yang zer/ pos gsan gsung*/ phyis bla ma hang du dkar pos rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid las gsan gsungs/ bla ma hang du dkar po la bal po lo tsā ba ye shes sdes gsan gsung*/ de la rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos gsan no// de'i zhal nas ngas rje btsun ma mang du thos pa na int+ra bhu ti'i chos su 'di ka legs par 'dug gsung*/ de la zhal gnyis ma chung ba dang sngags kyi de nyid grub pa ste chos gnyis po ni mi dbang nyid kyis mdzad la/ las bcu ni de'i gdams ngag snyan brgyud rnams bla ma bha rand+ra ru tsis gzhung du bkod pa yin no// me nyag 'ga' yi yul du skyes pa yi// tsang nge ston pa dge slong shes rab grags// de yis gsol ba btab nas las bcu yi// gsal byed dpal ldan sa skyar 'bad de sbyar// dge ba de yis nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i// 'gro kun log pa'i lam dang bral gyur nas// zab mo'i lam dang 'phrad par gyur nas ni// byang chub dam pa myur du thob par shog /shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis yi ger bkod pa'o// ༈ /na mo badzra bha rā hi ye/ lus gzhal yas khang du bsgom pa'i lte bar padma nyi ma ro'i gdan la/ zhal gnyis ma dmar mo g.yas phag zhal g.yon lha'i zhal/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa/ g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum du bsams la oṃ gsum ma bzlas so// don 'grub ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/

khro mo thung zhing sbom pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs par bsgoms pa/ oṃ badzra bha rā hi a bhi sha ya sarba puṣṭiṃ hrī swā hā/ zhes bzlas so// dbu bcad ma ser ba ser ba'i mdangs can/ g.yas kyi gri gug gis rang gi dbu bcad nas g.yon pas steng phyogs su 'dzin/ g.yas gri gug 'og phyogs su brkyang ba/ g.yon du rab sngags ma ljang gu/ g.yon brkyang ba/ g.yas su rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma ser mo/ g.yas brkyang ba/ gnyis ka'ang gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin par bsams la/ oṃ sarba bhuddha ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra wa ṇṇa nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra be ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas so// byin gyis brlabs la gsol ba gdab pa nas/ ye shes dbab pa'i bar gcig tu byas nas dbang bzhi so sor bskur/ rjes gnang rnams dus gcig tu mdzad nas gnang ngo*// ༈ / phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs kyi ngag 'don rnams bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor bsgrub par 'dod pas/ bla ma dam pa la dbang dang byin rlabs yang dag par thob cing dam tshig dang gdams pa la gnas pas/ shin tu dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su rten dang maṇḍal dang mchod pa la sogs pa tshul bzhin du bshams/ stan bde ba la kha nub tu bltas te rnal 'byor gyi 'dug pas 'dug la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la dad gus dang skyabs 'gro bya/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa sngon du btang*/ de nas chang byin gyis rlabs/ der g.yon pa'i srin lag gis chos 'byung bris la gru gsum mdun nas g.yon skor du oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang dbus su bam̐ bsam zhing bam̐ las 'od 'phros te/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te rang rang gi rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs nas bde ba chen po dang ldan pa'i sbyor mtshams nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs shing mthar thams cad der bstim zhing yi ge dang bcas pa gnyis su med par bsam/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum dang ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum brjod pas byin rlabs/ de nas lag pa byin brlabs pa ni/ g.yon pa'i mthil du oṃ bam̐ dmar mo/ mthe'u chung la ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo/ srin lag la hriṃ moṃ dkar mo/ gung mo la hriṃ hriṃ ser mo/ mdzub mo la hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu/ mthe bong la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams dgod do// de nas g.yon pa'i srin lag gis chang blangs te/ snying ga dang lkog ma dang dpral ba rnams su hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ bkod la/ yid dang ngag dang lus rnams la lan gsum reg pas bsrung zhing byin gyis rlabs bo// de nyid yang blangs te bcom ldan 'das ma'i sngags brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas lag pa chang gis mnyes la lus thams cad byugs cing khrus byas la rdo rje'i lus su bsam/ yang mchod pa rnams la 'bru gsum brjod cing gtor bas bgegs dang nyes skyon thams cad bsal nas/ phyi nang mchod pa dang mchod pa'i lha mor byin gyis brlabs nas/ de nas oṃ swā bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ badzra shuddhaḥsarba dha rmāḥbadzra shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ zhes pa gsum gyi sngags brjod pas rim pa ltar gzung ba dang*/ 'dzin pa dang*/ gnyis med kyi shes pa rnams bdag med pa/ rang gi lus khams gsum po rnam par dag cing stong pa'i gzhal yas khang du bsam/ de nas skad cig gis me 'bar ba'i chos 'byung gi lte bar sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i steng du mi ro gsar pa gan rgyal du mgo g.yon du bstan pa'i snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gnyis kyi g.yas don dam pa mtshon pa'i phag gdong nag mo gyen du gzigs pa/ g.yon kun rdzob mtshon pa'i khro mo'i zhal dmar mo cung zad mthur du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas nyon mongs dang rnam rtog gcod pa'i gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/

gru khug g.yon pa nas thabs mtshon pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ dbu skra grol zhing thur du 'phyang ba/ gcer bu spyan gsum pa/ gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhabs g.yas kyi mthil gyis g.yon pa'i brla la bstan pa/ g.yon gyi brang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du btsugs pa/ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa la sogs gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin du bsgom par bya ste/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa'o// de nas ye shes pa gzhug pa ni/ rang gi lte ba'i bam̐ las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ 'og min nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ yid kyis mchod/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dgug gzhug byed cing dbang du bya/ de nas lus la go cha dgod pa ni/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo/ spyi bor hriṃ hriṃ ser mo/ spyi gtsug du hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu/ lag mthil du phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams dgod/ de nas dbang bskur ba ni lte ba'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros te/ 'og min nas 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs spyan drangs/ yid kyis mchod cing dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ zhes ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pas dbang bskur zhing rang gi tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ lus thams cad rim gyis gang*/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni dngos su bshams pa dang*/ lte ba'i bam̐ la mchod pa dang*/ mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros te/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhuppe āḥhūm̐/

oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ghandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dyā āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ gzhan yang gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ sgra rdo rje ma dang*/ dri rdo rje ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma dang*/ reg bya rdo rje ma la sogs pas tshul bzhin du mchod/ de nas lha mo thams cad kyi phyag g.yas na ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing bdag la g.yon nas lan gsum bskor ba byed cing*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs kyis bstod nas/ mthar lte ba la sogs pa'i gnas su gnyis su med par thim zhing bde ba chen po dang ldan par bsam/ de nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi spyi bo'i bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma nyid dang mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong la sogs pa rnams la g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis tshul bzhin du mchod cing mthar rang gi lce la bzhag bde ba chen po dang ldan par bsam mo// de ltar bstod cing rgyas par mchod pas bsgoms shing bzlas par bya ba'i tshul 'di ltar/ gsang gnas su chos 'byung gru gsum pa rtsa ba'i sngags rim pa gsum yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ steng phag zhal gyi spyan dbus ma'i thad kar g.yung drung ris dmar po gnyis gsal btab la 'og rlung 'then cing steng rlung cung zad mnan nas 'khor lo gnyis g.yon du drag tu dmar khyi li li 'od zer dmar po 'bar ba dang bcas pas 'khor ba la dmigs nas/ rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas las su rung ste/ bde ba dang gsal ba dang mi rtog pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan par 'gyur ro// gzhan yang gsang gnas kyi chos 'byung gi dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i bam̐ dang spyi gtsug gi haṃ mgo thur la bstan pa dang*/ de gnyis kyi bar du rtsa dbu ma gro sog tsam gnas pa gsal btab ste/ 'og rlung 'then steng rlung mnan pas rlung me'i drod can gyis chos 'byung gi yi ge rnams spros te/

'od zer bam̐ la phog cing spros pas 'phar la khad 'phur la khad la dbu ma'i nang nas yar glog gi 'od zer ltar song ste/ spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas zhu nas byang chub kyi sems dbu ma nas mar skya na ra ra babs te/ lte ba'i bam̐ dang 'dres shing de ltar byang sems dkar dmar 'dres pa de chos 'byung gi sngags la thim zhing des lus thams cad gang bar bsgoms pas/ sems las su rung zhing bde ba dang gsal ba dang mi rtog pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan par 'gyur ro// gzhan yang bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas lus snad pa'i tshor ba dang*/ dgra chen po'i mi bsad pa dang*/ rmi lam du byang chub chen po thob par rmi ba dang*/ smig rgyu la sogs pa'i rtags dang ldan zhing*/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub nyid myur du thob par 'gyur ro// gal te bsam gtan la ldang bar 'dod na/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das la gus 'dud bya zhing*/ gtor ma phul la yi ge brgya pa brjod de/ gnyis su med pa'i blos chos dang mthun pa'i spyod lam bya'o// bsnyen pa'i dus sam skabs su bzlas pa bya bar 'dod na/ bla ma dang gsang gnas kyi yi ge la rtse gcig tu dmigs te bzlas pa bya'o// gzhan yang zhi ba la sogs pa'i skabs su chos 'byung la rtsa ba'i sngags sum rim du bkod la rtse gcig tu dmigs la 'gog pa'i tshul gyis yid la bzlas pas 'jigs pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs shing dngos grub thams cad thob par 'gyur ro// ༈ / phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa bzhugs// ༈ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs nyams su len par 'dod pas/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su kha nub tu bltas te/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa byas la/ rang gi mdun ka ra'am sbrang la bdud rtsi ril bu btab la/ dngos su yod pa'am med na yang bsams te/

g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar la g.yon skor du chos 'byung bris pa'i tshul du byed/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan mang po'am ci nus/ dbus su bam̐ zhes brjod pas/ phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bdud rtsi'i char phab pas thod pa gang bar bsam/ bdud rtsi dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga gsum du reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ de nas lag pa g.yas pas g.yon pa'i lag mthil bdud rtsi nas oṃ bam̐ zhes pa dang*/ mthe chung ham̐ yoṃ/ srin lag la hriṃ moṃ/ gung mo la hriṃ hriṃ/ mdzub mo la hūm̐ hūm̐/ mthe bong la phaṭa phaṭa brjod pas lha'i rang bzhin du bsams la/ lus dag cing mi dmigs par bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswā bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ stong pa nyid du bsgom zhing dag par bsam/ oṃ badzra shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥbadzra shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ zung 'jug ste yid dag par bsgoms/ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ gis skad cig las bdag gi lus khams gsum rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin chos 'byung lha'i gzhal yas khang gi ngo bor bsgom/ yang bdag gi lte ba'i nang du zla ba'i steng du aṃ gyur pa'i bam̐ yig dmar po/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ 'byung ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ gru mo g.yon pa'i khug na kha ṭwāṃ ga dar dpyang dang dril bu sil sil sgra 'byin pa/ dbu skra sil bur thur du 'phyang ba/ gcer bu zhal gnyis ka'ang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ bu mo lo bcu drug lon pa'i cha byad can/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i rang bzhin thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ zhabs g.yon pa'i brla na g.yas pa'i brang nga sbyar ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i tshul gyis padma dang nyi ma'i steng du ro mnan pa/ dza ba'i me tog gam sindhu ra'i mdog ltar dmar ba/

rtsa ba'i zhal ni kun rdzob rnam par dag pa'i khro mo'i zhal lo// g.yas ni don dam pa rnam par dag pa phag gdong sngon po'o// de nas gong ltar lag pa byin gyis brlabs te/ gnas drug tu zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo oṃ bam̐ brjod cing lag mthil lte bar reg rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo/ snying khar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo mthe'u chung snying khar reg gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo srin lag kha la/ rmongs byed ma/ spyi bor hriṃ hriṃ ser mo gung mo spyi bo/ skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ ljang gu mdzub mo spyi gtsug tu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha mthe bong dpung pa la/ tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo/ de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bskor zhing phaiṃ zhes brjod pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs la/ oṃ badzra bhā rā hi sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro bas arghaṃ pra tā+-itstsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin du pa dyaṃ= puṣpe= dhu pe= ā lo ke= gha ndhe= nai wi dyā= shabda āḥhūm̐ gis mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi lus la thim par bsgom/ yang phyag rgya dang phaiṃ zhes brjod pas/ dbang bskur gyi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu mam̐ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa'i chus/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bdag gi spyi bo nas dbang bskur lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bo'i 'khor lo'i steng du mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas gong ltar arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas bdud rtsi myang*/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod pa'am/

yang na/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod cing lha'i rnam pa la cung zad sems bzung*/ rdzogs rim ni gsang gnas su 'khor lo gru gsum nyis brtsegs/ g.yas g.yon gyi zur bzhi la g.yung drung 'khyil pa bzhi/ lte ba'i zla ba'i steng du bam̐ gyi mtha' mar oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyis bskor ba de'i 'od phyir byung ste/ phag gdong gi dpral bar g.yung drung 'khyil pa myur du g.yon du 'khor ba la dmigs shing*/ rlung kha sbyar yid bzlas ci 'grub bya/ de nas ngag gi bzlas pa yang khas blangs kyi tshad dam/ ji ltar nus pa byas te/ slar yang rje btsun ma rdo rje phag mos bdag gi phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub mkha' spyod chen po'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ ces gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ 'chi tshe dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyis// me tog rgyal mtshan gdugs sogs thogs nas kyang*// rol mo glu dang sgra dbyangs sogs mchod nas// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog /zhes brjod nas go cha'i sngags rnams dang*/ sumbha ni tshar gnyis brjod nas bsrung ba byas nas spyod lam la 'jug 'di'i rdzogs rim rgyas pa dang*/ gtor ma la sogs pa ni rje btsun nyid kyis mdzad pa'i yig char gsal/ rje btsun chen po'i gsung rab las// legs par bsdus pa'i bdud rtsi'i bcud// gang gis myang ba tsam gyis kyang*// mkha' spyod chen po thob par 'gyur// zhes pa 'di yang ma ti tsi tras brag dkar chos sdings su sbyar ba'o// ༈ /

phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i byin rlabs sa lugs kyi yi ge gung rus mdzad pa bzhugs// ༈ /phag mo zhal gnyis ma 'di/ rgyal po ind+ra bhu tis mdzad pa 'dra yang*/ bla ma dpyal ba rnams las brgyud pa/ yang phag mo zhal bstan bha rend+ra'i slob ma lo tsā ba ye shes sde la sa chen gyis gsan nas sa skya pa nas brgyud pa 'di ni phyag len legs shing*/ gzhung 'gyur yang grags 'byor shes rab dang*/ ye shes sdes mdzad pa bzang*/ de'ang mi dbang chos gsum la rje btsun pas ṭīkka mdzad la/ byin rlabs byed tshul ni bla ma bdag bskyed bum bzlas sngon du song nas/ chos 'byung bsnol mar bam̐ dang zur la go cha'i sngags bris pa'i steng du bdud rtsi byin rlabs can sindhu ra'i chos 'byung bsnol mar bam̐ dang gtso bo'i sngags rnams bris la der rje btsun ma bskyed/ mchod bstod sogs bya/ byin rlabs bdag 'jug tu blangs la/ slob ma bos la yon dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ces lan gsum dang rgyun bshags/ gdong ras/ khaṇḍa ro hi dang bum chus bsang*/ dris lan sems bskyed/ dam tshig dzaḥhūm̐ gis nang du gzhug ye shes dbab pa'i yon/ gsol ba gdab pa/ de nas rkang pa'i 'og tu yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can/ rkang mthil du dzhaiṃ sum mdor me gru gsum bsam/ de nas rlung des dzhaiṃ bskul te brla rtsar zhugs/ sum mdo'i me dang bsdongs nas lus bde drod 'od kyi rang bzhin sbyangs par bsams la/ oṃ yo ga shuddha sogs dang sarba dharmāḥshuddho sogs brjod de/ bde stong gi ngang la zhal gnyis mar bskyed/ go cha dgod/ phaiṃ sgras sindhu ra dang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' spyan drangs la bstim/ yang de'i snying gar chos 'byung bsnol ma la bam̐ bsam/

de las 'od 'phros pas dbu mar zhugs/ spyi bo'i steng nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams 'od du zhu nas snying gar thim pas/ bde stong gi lta ba la sems thim par bsam/ bla mas ḍā dril dang dbab/ yang chos 'byung de lte bar 'khor zhing babs pa'i 'od zer de g.yas ro mar song ste/ g.yas phag zhal gyi smin mtshams su dga' ba 'khyil pa phog ste 'khor zhing 'od zer 'bar bas bde stong gi nyams skyes par bsam pa'i ngang las sangs rgyas byang sems bstims la/ bla mas sngar ltar dbab/ yang chos 'byung mar gsang gnas su babs shing 'khor bas bde drod skyes pa'i ngang la sangs rgyas byang sems bstims la/ bla mas sngar ltar dbab/ de nas tiṣṭhas brtan la/ mig ras bsal la/ bla mas tshom bu sku'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ bdud rtsi gsung gi dkyil 'khor/ sindhu ra thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/ zhes dang*/ lha ngo bstan no// de nas dbang la yon dang*/ byang chub rdo rje sogs gsol ba gdab/ sngon ltar lhar gsal/ yi ge gsum gyi 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas byang sems sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor dang rang bzhin nas bstim/ bla mas bde mchog drug cu'i dbang lha spyan drangs la/ gsol ba gdab/ oṃ gsum mas bum dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ yang bdud rtsi sbyin/ de nas sin dkyil zhu nas/ de'i sngags phreng gi rdul blangs la srin lag gis lte bar bskus nas drod skyes par bsam/ zur gyi dga' ba 'khyil pa'i rdul smin mtshams su bskus pas sangs rgyas byang sems kyi dga' bzhi'i rtogs pa thams cad skyes par bsam/ yang sin dkyil zur nas go cha'i sngags rdul rnams blangs nas spyi bor bskus pas thams cad sangs rgyas byang sems kyi go cha'i sngags kyis khyab par bsam/ de nas rang sems bde ba chen po'i stong par bltas la/ 'di ni rang nyid mdzes ma ste// sogs brjod/ de nas gtso bos sogs dang*/

yon dang*/ bdag bran sogs brjod la/ rjes kyi bya ba rnams bya'o// 'di'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ lwa ba pa/ ind+ra bhu ti/ lcam legs smin/ birwa pa/ sha ba ri pa/ mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ bha rend+ra ru tsi/ bal po ye shes rdo rje/ sa chen yab sras gsum/ chos rje khu dbon gnyis/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po// ༈ /i nd+ra mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs dang byin rlabs kyi cho ga bklags chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so// ༈ /padma mi ro nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng*// skye rgu skyabs gcig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// bden gnyis don mtshon zhal zung ldan pa yis// 'gro kun 'khor ba'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol// 'dir 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbang dang rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pas phag mo zhal gnyis ma bsgom pa'i tshul la/ skyabs sems yig brgya tshad med bzhi spyi ltar bya/ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/ gnas lugs kyi don la blo cung zad bzhag stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum pa phyi rol thams cad me ri 'bar ba/ de'i lte bar padma mi ro nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gnyis kyi g.yas don dam pa mtshon pa'i phag zhal nag po/ g.yon kun rdzob mtshon pa'i khro mo'i zhal dmar po cung zad thur du gzigs pa/ zhal gnyis ka'ang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra sil bu thur du grol ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo g.yon pa na thabs mtshon pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ sku gcer bu la rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyi thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon pa'i brla la g.yas pa'i sor mo gtad pa'i phyed krung gi tshul/

zhabs g.yon pa'i mthil nyi ma'i steng du btsugs pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo zhes sogs kyi go cha dkyus bzhin/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya phaiṃ gyi sgra dang bcas pas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas bdag gi lus la bstim/ yang 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang phaiṃ zhes brjod pas dbang bskur gyi lha 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ bdag la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas lha rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bdag gi spyi bo nas dbang bskur te lus gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bo'i steng du mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar arghaṃ la sogs pas phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ de nas spro na rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin rdzogs rim kyang bsgom/ bzlas pa ni snying gar nyi ma'i steng du bam̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer spro bsdu dang*/ lha'i rnam pa la dmigs pa gtad pa'i sgo nas oṃ gsum ma ci nus bzla/ mthar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang yig brgya brjod/ dge ba 'di yis myur du sogs kyis bsngo ba bya/ byin rlabs bya ba'i tshul ni/ tshes bcu gnyis gang yang rung ba la/ gnas dben par rdul tshon dmar pos chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs bris/ rtsibs drug la rdul tshon dkar pos shar rtsibs nas bzung ste/ oṃ bam̐/ ham̐ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pa rnams yig mgo phyir bstan la bri/ de'i dbus su bam̐ bri/ de'i khar mañtsi'i steng ka pā la'i nang du chang la bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar bas bkang ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa bzhag

de'i steng maṇḍal gyi steng sindhu ra'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs de'i dbus su bam̐ gyi mthar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bris la/ zur bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba bris pa re bzhag de'i mdun nam khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang*/ gtor ma gnyis sam gsum bshams/ bum pa dri bzang dung chos gzungs rdor dang bcas pa dang*/ 'og tu slob mar dgos pa'i mig dar me tog sogs dang*/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod rdor dril bzhag de nas slob dpon gdan la 'dug la skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar mngon rtogs dkyus bzhin bsgom/ de nas rang gi mdun gyi nang mchod dang*/ sindhu ra'i 'og thod chang la dmigs te/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bdud rtsi byin rlabs rgyas pa'am bsdu na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum gyis byin brlab/ sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor dang rdul tshon la dmigs te/ sum bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs mtha' me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su rnal 'byor ma mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed/ de la go cha dgod/ ye shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang lha spyan drangs nas dbang bskur zhing mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa rnams mngon rtogs bzhin dang*/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra'i mthar arghaṃ sogs so sor sbyor nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod byin rlabs dran par byas la/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yi dam gyi lha rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du= chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rigs drug gi sems can la sbyin/ yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ bsdu na/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/

de nas bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa dkyus bzhin bskyed la/ de'i dbus su ji skad bshad pa'i gdan gyi steng du bam̐ las rdo rje phag mo zhal gnyis ma yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ de la phyi mchod nang mchod dang*/ bstod pas bstod la gzungs thag nas bzung la oṃ gsum ma bzlas pas/ sngags kyi 'od zer bdag gi zhal nas 'phros te gzungs thag la 'khril nas bum nang du song bas rnal 'byor ma'i sku la phog pas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ste bum pa'i nang du bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis mer gang bar bsam zhing oṃ gsum ma brgya rtsa bzlas/ slar mchod bstod byas la/ dung chos kyi chu bum nang du blugs pas rje btsun ma 'od du zhu ba bdud rtsi'i chu dang dbyer med du gyur/ de nas gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la oṃ gsum ma'i mthar i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma dang po rnal 'byor ma la phul/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi mchod dang nang mchod dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis bstod/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ de nas gtor ma gzhan la dmigs nas chos skyong gtor ma bsngo ba rim pa bzhin du bya ba'am yang na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dkyus bzhin gyis chog 'dir slob dpon gyis bdag 'jug len pa ma gsungs pas ma byas kyang 'gal ba med/ spro na maṇḍal gsol gdab nas bzung*/ gtso bos ji ltar gyi bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin blang*/ de nas slob ma bos la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du zhes pa nas/ byin rlabs kyi bka' zhu snyam pa'i bsam pa sems bskyed du gzhug gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i dmar mo skor gsum gyi nang nas ind+ra mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs yin/

de la sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba bdag mdun bum gsum gyi rim pa rnams bsgrubs zin/ da khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ slob dpon rje btsun mar gsal ba la byin rlabs kyi bka' zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍa 'bul du gzhug ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gi phreng ba gtad la/ bla ma yi dam gyi lha la gsol ba gdab pa 'di gsung bar zhu/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// lan gsum/ de nas/ sdig pa bshags pa nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i dmigs pa brda sprad la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs kyi rgyun bshags lan gsum/ da khyed rang rnams thugs 'dun pa ma yengs par 'di la snyan gtad par zhu/ rtog pas g.yogs pa'i sems kyis ni// legs pa'i sangs rgyas phyir bzlog ltar// dad pa'i chu yis bkrus pa'i sems// phan pa'i sems kyis 'dir 'jug bya// dad pa med pa'i sems can la// dkar po'i chos rnams mi 'byung ste// ji ltar sa bon 'tshig pa la// myu gu sngon po skye mi srid// ces gsungs te de'i don yang rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs la/ bla ma dang lha la dad gus drag po bskyed cing chos nyams su len pa'i spro ba dung pa re skyed par zhu/ ku shas bum chu nas gtor la/ sumbha brjod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis mig dar bcing*/ lag pa g.yon pas khu tshur gyi se gol phyogs bzhir gtogs shing sumbha brjod pas bsrung ba bya/ slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus nas dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbarjod/ gu gul gyi dud pas bskor zhing*/ ye shes dbab pa'i slad du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin gnang bar zhu/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥbadzra shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/

zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus snang stong sgyu ma lta bu de yang mi dmigs par bsgom/ de'i ngang las skad cig gis chos 'byung nyis brtsegs me ri 'bar ba'i lte bar padma mi ro nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du khyed rang rnams rje btsun ma sku mdog dmar mo zhes pa nas/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed pa'am/ lte bar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su bam̐ yig sngags phreng gis bskor ba/ zur bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa gsal gdab/ bam̐ de las 'od zer 'phros pas g.yas ro ma nas yar song*/ 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim/ spyi gtsug gi haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dbu ma nas byung nas lte bar babs pa la thugs gtad pas drod skyes/ yang lte ba nas 'od zer 'phros/ g.yas ro ma nas song ste zhal g.yas pa'i phag gdong gi g.yung drung 'khyil pa la phog ste/ de g.yon du myur du 'khor ba la dmigs pa gtad par zhu/ mi rtog pa skyes/ yang lte ba'i 'khor lo de gsang gnas su phab ste myur du 'khor ba la sems gtad par zhu/ bde ba skyes/ de ltar na bde ba mi rtog pa'i ngang la cung zhig 'jog par zhu/ dril bu'i sgra chung ba dkrol la/ oṃ gsum ma brjod/ de ltar ye shes phab pas lus kyi ba spu ldang ba la sogs pa'am/ ngag tu sngags brjod pa'am/ sems la mi rtog pa skye ba la sogs pa ci rigs pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ de brtan par bya ba'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag la/ oṃ tiṣṭha badzra ye shes brtan par gyur cig ces brjod/ sngar gyi me tog de nyid rje btsun mar phul la oṃ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥbarjod du 'jug slar me tog sngags kyi phreng bar bsgyur te spyi gtsug tu bzhag la/ oṃ pra ti gṛhna badzra sogs brjod/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi// zhes sogs dang bcas pas mig dar bsal la lha ngo bstan/

de yan chad kyis 'jug pa'i chos song*/ dngos gzhi'i slad du maṇḍal/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol gdab lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ rje btsun ma'i mdun ngos su dbang stegs chos 'byung dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi lte bar pad nyi'i steng du khyed rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i spyi bor gdugs/ g.yas g.yon du rgyal mtshan ba dan/ khor yug tu mchod pa'i phreng bas bskor ba dang bcas te bzhugs pa'i mos pa gnang*/ slob dpon rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ phyag tu bum pa thogs nas dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ spyi bor bum pa bzhag la/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ gi bar brjod/ bum chu sbyin/ de ltar dbang bskur bas lus thams cad byang chub sems kyi chus gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa'i mos pa gnang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las sngags kyi phreng ba chad/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang gi khar zhugs/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig la g.yon skor du 'khod par bsams la/ 'di'i rjes zlos gsung bar zhu/ oṃ gsum ma lan gsum/ slob mas me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs bya/ des bum pa'i dbang thob pa yin no// zhes ngo sprad/ de nas sindhu ra'i thod chang blangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing slob ma la bdud rtsi re sbyin/ slob dpon gyis oṃ gsum ma bzlas/ des gsang dbang thob pa yin no// zhes ngo sprad/ de nas yang sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi sngags phreng rnams slob dpon gyi srin lag g.yon pas blangs la slob ma'i srin lag g.yon par bskus la rang rang gi lte bar byug tu gzhug chung ba yin/ slob dpon gyis oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig bzla/ de nas sindhu ra'i sngags phreng rnams lte bar thim par mos pa mdzod/

yang dga' ba 'khyil pa'i sindhu ra rnams blangs la oṃ gsum ma bzla zhing dpral bar byugs pas dga' ba 'khyil pa rnams smin mtshams su thim par bsam/ yang 'og gi go cha'i rdul tshon rnams blangs la/ go cha'i sngags rnams bzla zhing spyi gtsug tu byug go cha'i sngags rnams spyi gtsug tu thim par mos pa mdzod/ des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa yin no// zhes ngo sprad/ dbang bzhi pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos// nam mkha' lta bur dri med par// stong pa'i ye shes rdo rje yis// stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom// zhes gsungs te de'i don ye gdod ma nas dngos po dang dngos po med pa la sogs pa'i spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu skye 'gag mtha' dbus dang bral ba de'i ngang du cung zhig 'jog par zhu/ de ni dbang bzhi pa yin no// zhes ngo sprad/ de'i gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa srung sdom bgyi snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ maṇḍal sogs 'dra/ slar slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa bya/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya brjod cing nongs pa bzod par gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ bsngo ba dang shis brjod kyi phreng bas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// de ltar ind+ra mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs dang byin rlabs kyi cho ga zung du 'brel ba 'di ni phyag len gyi bka' mi nub par bya ba'i phyir rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang phag mo'i las bcu'i nang gi byin rlabs kyi cho ga gzhir bzhag la/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po yab sras kyi gsung gi zin thos brgyan te dge slong ngag dbang chos grags kyis chu mo bya'i lo zla ba bdun pa'i yar tshes brgyad kyi nyin spu dkar bla brang rdzong du bris pa'i yi ge pa ni chos grags bzang po'o// 'dis kyang bstan pa dar zhing skye rgu rnams bde legs su gyur cig

brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ grub chen lwa ba pa/ rgyal chen ind+ra bhā ti/ lcam lakṣ+mī ka ra/ bram ze birwa pa/ sha ba ri pa/ grub chen mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ bal po bha rend+ra ru tsi/ bal po ye shes rdo rje/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun sku mched/ chos rje khu dbon/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ grub chen brag phug pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos rgyal/ gu shri pa nam mkha' bzang po/ nyi lde ba ngag dbang grags pa/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje bla ma dam pa dbang phyug rab brtan/ des bdag la'o// ༈ /
